title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 prane Rruges Qemal Stafa ne zonen e Pazarit te ri.
description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte te banimit te nje godine te mireadministruar me ashensor.
Apartamenti ka nje gjendje shume te mire dhe eshte i rinovuar totalisht para 6 muajsh.
Apartamenti eshte nje mundesi e shkelqyer per investim pasi jepet me qira ditore aktualisht,dhe fitimi eshte i konsiderueshem.
Ka nje mobilim shume te mire dhe shitet si ne foto.Organizohet ne nje koridor,nje tualet,nje sallon dhe nje dhome gjumi.
Prona nuk disponon Certifikate pronesie por Dokumentacioni eshte i rregullt (Kontrate kalimi te drejtash)
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale near Qemal Stafa Street in the new Pazar area.
description_en: The apartment is located on the second floor of a well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is in a very good condition and was completely renovated 6 months ago. The apartment is an excellent opportunity for investment as it is currently rented daily, and the profit is considerable. It has very good furniture and is sold as in the photo. It is organized in a corridor, a toilet, a living room and a bedroom. The property does not have a certificate of ownership, but the documentation is in order (transfer of rights contracts)
